ideas.title: POD Merch / Statement Brand (skizofrenick sage)
ideas.vision: Low-capital, high-automation print-on-demand brand. Clever, slightly unhinged mantras and sayings on T-shirts, stickers, and posters. Printify (preferred margins) or Printful → simple Shopify storefront. Zero inventory, near-zero ongoing labor once the first designs are live. Pure creative outlet that can run on autopilot and potentially throw off side cash.
ideas.synergies: Creative pressure-release that doesn’t compete with PE / agent work. Practice writing tight copy and generating visual assets. Fits the Quiet Production / One Agent ethos — set it up once and let it live. Could later become a small brand asset or proof of productized creative systems.
options: Weekend: lock 5–8 core statements + generate first mockups
Next: Printify account + order 1–2 physical samples
Later: simple Shopify (or Amazon Merch parallel) and decide on final brand name
bullets: Lock brand name / handle (skizofrenick sage or alternatives)
Generate mockups and order 1–2 physical samples
